title: oh.war/model/v1 (Format 1.0 section 8)
description: Hand-written and normative for docs/format/FORMAT-1.0.md section 8 (and section 9 for the digests). Where this schema and the prose disagree, the prose wins and this schema is the defect. The canonical JSON model a reader produces. Absent optional members are omitted, never `null`. A consumer MUST ignore members it does not know, so every object here admits members it does not name. Not expressed here, and checked by a conformance case instead: the sort orders (records by `id`; relations by `(from, kind, to, to_revision)`; states by `(record, kind, value)`; diagnostics by `(rule, record, message)`, all by UTF-8 bytes), RFC 8785 serialization, and the digest values. schemas/oh.war/model/v1.json is generated from the reference implementation and describes what it emits today, a subset section 8 says it owes additions to.

format.description: The highest format version the reader implements.

basis_digest.description: `sha256:` of the RFC 8785 bytes of the array of `[id, revision]` pairs, in record order.

type.description: As authored. A core type, a profile's type, or a legacy store's type (`adr`, `roadmap`, `phase`).

title.description: The heading's title; absent only for legacy records with none.

document.description: The global id of the work document that holds the record; absent otherwise.

section.description: The id of the last section opened before the record in its document; absent if none.

span.description: `[start, end]` byte offsets of the unit's span, `[start, end)` (section 3.4).

revision.description: `sha256:` of the exact bytes of the span (section 9).

fields.description: Name to string, or to an array of strings for a frontmatter list. `{}` when none.

body.description: The body text, exactly; `""` when none.

ext.description: Dotted names to value; `{}` when none. The prose does not fix the value's type.

governed_by.description: Under the authority profile; absent otherwise. The prose does not fix its type beyond a value; the reference implementation writes a string.

state.description: A value computed from records, journals and recorded acts (section 2). Never authored.
